t: Test SPA Endpoints (Single Page Applications in FastHTML)
s: This article details the development of an app plugin framework in FastHTML, focusing on self-hosted, private applications. It outlines initial projects like a To-Do list clone and addresses proprietary data security concerns, culminating in the creation of comprehensive `pytest` tests for FastHTML endpoints.
sub: Proprietary Data Security for Online Apps
Self-Hosted To-Do List App as Priority Project
